item.itunes:title: Episode 15: Our TV and Movie Favourites
item.title: Episode 15: Our TV and Movie Favourites
item.itunes:author: Red Circle Productions
item.itunes:summary:
In today’s episode we have a quick catch-up on how our Septembers have been now we’ve all left school. Then we go through our top 5 films and TV shows to help you guys have the perfect night in, whether you’re recovering from a Uni hangover, avoiding school work or you just need a break! Click now to listen :)
Follow us on Instagram! @thelittlewomenpodcast
Support this podcast at — https://redcircle.com/little-women/donations
